title: International Tax Type Setup — a GOV tax type without a GOV Reg. Number is not flagged
requirementSource: NM-4026 — TestRail C107663: flagged "GOV Tax Reg Number is required", as a Provincial type is; Save disabled
stepsToReproduce: Open Tax → International Tax Type Setup for office 1606 (/navigator/locations/1606/taxes/international-tax-type-setup) on e2e.
On a province with no record pick GOV type IVA, leave GOV Reg. Number empty and type Effective Date 01/15/2030.
expectedBehavior: The row shows "GOV Tax Reg Number is required" and Save is disabled (as for a Provincial type, TC-TAX-ITT-028).
actualBehavior: No message is shown on the row.

verificationLog.finding: Failed in the full run and the isolated rerun; the Provincial equivalent (TC-TAX-ITT-028) passes.
